limitations: Guest/unconfigured checks use the production bridge and browser memory storage with an explicitly empty test-response configuration, independent of deployed public settings.

Configured account, admin, Google API contract and cloud checks replace SDK transport in a routed HTML response with a deterministic test double. Every fixture replaces the configuration generically and blocks external network requests. No production test switch exists.
These checks do not prove live Google OAuth, Supabase delivery, hosted RLS or a deployed account service.
